name: scene_store
prompt: Edit the FIRST image (the night-time cartoon gas station). Keep the composition, camera, cartoon style, night lighting and everything on the left EXACTLY as it is: the gas canopy with the red neon FALCOS sign, the woman leaning on the black SUV smoking, the pump, the bollards and the wet ground. Keep the big shop window on the right in the same place and size with the cashier and customer inside exactly as they are. Restyle ONLY the convenience store building to look like the store in the SECOND image (a real photo), drawn in the same polished cartoon style at night: a wide blue corrugated-metal fascia band along the top of the store with big white block letters reading exactly "FALCO'S C STORE" (spelled F-A-L-C-O-apostrophe-S, then a big red-orange letter C, then S-T-O-R-E), white painted block wall below the fascia, a low red-orange brick wall along the bottom of the store front, a glass entrance door with a dark aluminium frame, dark-framed windows, and bundles of firewood stacked on wooden pallets against the wall next to the door. Warm interior light glowing through the glass, wall lamps on, the blue fascia lit softly from below. Same cartoon style with bold ink outlines and cel shading. No other text anywhere.
